name: rana_play_music
description: Play audio from a media URL in the requester's current Discord voice channel. MUST call this when a guild message asks Rana to play a URL. Use sender_id as requester_id so the bridge can find the user's live voice channel. Do not reply NO_REPLY when this tool succeeds.

url.description: The full media URL to play.

guild_id.description: Discord guild/server ID. Use the configured fallback 1486679037605842944 if unavailable.

channel_id.description: Optional Discord voice channel ID. Do not use chat_id/text channel ID.

requester_id.description: Discord user ID of the requester. Use sender_id from Discord metadata.

response_handling.status_queued: Reply in character that the song is playing using the title field.
response_handling.status_extracted: Reply that extraction worked but voice playback failed, using llm_hint.
response_handling.status_error: Reply with a short in-character error using llm_hint.
response_handling.http_error: Reply that the local music service is unavailable.
